feature.label: GitHub connection (OAuth)
feature.description: GitHub connector for the external connections framework

vars.description: GitHub OAuth App client ID for the GitHub connector.

instructions: 1. Create an OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers → New OAuth App.
3. Request scope 'repo' at connect time (configured by the connector).
4. Copy the Client ID from the app's General page.

vars.description: GitHub OAuth App client secret for the GitHub connector.

instructions: Generate a client secret from the same GitHub OAuth App's General page and copy it here.
